name: skafld-vc-platform
description: Only for firms that run a SkaFld VC platform: connects the SkaFld VC agents to your firm's pipeline, documents, rubric and house profile. Asks for your platform's address when installed and installs SkaFld VC with it. No platform? Install SkaFld VC on its own; to get a platform, contact hello@skafldstudio.com.

platform_url.title: Your SkaFld VC platform address
platform_url.description: The web address of your firm's SkaFld VC platform, such as https://vc.yourfirm.com (no trailing slash). Your platform admin can tell you. No platform? Cancel and install SkaFld VC on its own; to get one, contact hello@skafldstudio.com. Change it later with /plugin configure skafld-vc-platform.
